answer: Multi-guardian recovery with a veto window lets a quorum of guardians approve a reset while the owner keeps a final veto, and the bridge of the mechanism is that the veto period is long enough to notice abuse. The forge of the design is that guardians are weighted by trust, so a single new guardian cannot outweigh long-standing ones. A Sybil ring cannot stack the guardian set because guardians are appointed over time by the owner, and the willow of the veto means even a successful quorum can be stopped by the real owner.
